{{CorrectTitle|title=β-supervisor}}
'''''β-supervisors''''' were highly-skilled veteran [[Starship/Legends|starship]] builders who spent their entire lives working for [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. It was one of the eldest β-supervisors who, during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], stepped forward and reaffirmed his loyalty to KDY and the [[Kuat of Kuat/Legends|Kuat of Kuat]].
